# Perth is OK

> > A comprehensive local guide to Perth and Western Australia featuring events, dining, accommodation, lifestyle, and community stories.

Perth is OK is a community-focused lifestyle and events platform dedicated to showcasing the best of Perth and Western Australia. The site covers entertainment, dining, travel, real estate, sports, and local news, serving as a comprehensive resource for residents and visitors exploring the region.

## Key Topics

- Perth events
- Western Australia
- local news
- restaurants & dining
- things to do
- entertainment
- accommodation
- sports
- lifestyle
- Ningaloo
- Fremantle
- festivals
- community
- travel guide
- real estate

## Core Guides

- [Homepage](https://perthisok.com): Homepage showcasing Perth & WA events, entertainment, and local stories
- [Explore Perth](https://perthisok.com/explore): Travel guide to Perth attractions, beaches, parks, and destinations
- [Best Places to Eat & Drink](https://perthisok.com/eat-drink): Guide to Perth restaurants, bars, and dining venues with reviews
- [Accommodation & Stays](https://perthisok.com/stays): Accommodation guide featuring hotels, resorts, and stays in WA
- [Perth Homes](https://perthisok.com/homes): Perth real estate, home sales, designs, and property information

## News & Current Events

- [Perth News](https://perthisok.com/news): Latest Perth & Western Australia news covering sports, events, lifestyle
- [Sports News](https://perthisok.com/sports): Perth sports news covering AFL, netball, rugby, and local athletes
- [The Book of Mormon - October Perth](https://perthisok.com/event/the-book-of-mormon-is-coming-to-perth-this-october): Broadway musical The Book of Mormon returning to Crown Theatre Perth
- [Stirling Festival of Motoring](https://perthisok.com/event/stirling-festival-of-motoring): Stirling Festival of Motoring classic car show event announcement
- [Ningaloo Whale Shark Season 2026](https://perthisok.com/explore/ningaloo-whale-shark-season-is-officially-underway): Ningaloo whale shark season guide and wildlife tourism information
- [Albany to Perth Charity Cycle Ride](https://perthisok.com/sports/albany-perth-ride-for-youth-mental-health): Charity cycling event from Albany to Perth for youth mental health
